They were coached by [[Rick Pitino]], in his third year at the school and 37th overall. They played their home games at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The Red Storm had a breakout year under second year coach [[Rick Pitino]] where they finished the season 31–5, 18–2 in [[2024-25 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to win both the Big East regular season and tournament championship, and got a #2 seed to the NCAA Tournament.
